notes: UID matching is normalized: spaces, colons, hyphens are ignored and case-insensitive.
Replace UIDs with the actual UIDs of your physical NFC/RFID tags or cards.
When in Login mode, scanning an authorized UID authenticates the player profile.
When in Gameplay mode, scanning an item card grants in-game relics or triggers quests with anti-duplicate cooldown.
